The narration quotation “For I will destroy her speedily; yea, for I will be merciful unto my people, but the wicked shall perish.” includes punctuation and wording exactly, but presenting it as narration makes an unstated speaker attribution ambiguous.
The scene combines prophetic imagery and later outcomes in one entry; it must not portray the forecast beasts, satyrs, dragons, destruction, mercy, or perishing as present-tense events.
